errors.evidence: The description states that the values on the Y-axis are in percent, but there is no percentage sign (%) or label on the chart to indicate this unit. The prompt requires describing only visually present information.

errors.text_span: Визуално графиката показва линия, формирана от последователно свързани точки, като всяка точка отговаря на стойността за съответната година.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the chart as a standard line plot. The chart is actually a stem plot (or lollipop plot), where each data point is marked by a value at the top of a vertical line extending from the x-axis. This description completely omits the prominent vertical lines which are a key structural element of the chart.
The description fails to mention that the line connecting the data points is dashed. This is a significant and clearly visible stylistic feature of the plot.
